questions.stem_text:
Which State ordinarily exercises jurisdiction in respect of crimes committed on board
vessels?

options.D: The International Tribunal for the Law of the Sea

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - The flag State

questions.stem_text: What is an act jure imperii?

options.A: An act is jure imperii when undertaken by an international organisation
options.B: An act is jure imperii when undertaken in an official State capacity
options.C: All acts undertaken by State officials are acts jure imperii
options.D: An act is jure imperii when undertaken by a State corporation

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - An act is jure imperii when undertaken in an official State capacity

questions.stem_text:
"Natural law is based on the nature of man and on his inward need of living in society."
Who said it?

Which proposition below can be characterized as the most powerful refutation of Bentham's
argument in support of codification?

options.A: The law is too complex to be codified.
options.C: Bentham fails to take account of the criminal law.
options.D: Significant portions of the law are already codified.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - The law is too complex to be codified.

questions.stem_text:
Discuss the entities entitled to request advisory opinions from the International Court of
Justice and analyze the implications of these requests on international law and
governance.
questions.gold_answer:

question, as well as 'other organs of the United Nations and specialized agencies, which
may at any time be so authorized by the General Assembly, may also request advisory
opinions of the Court on legal questions arising within the scope of their activities'.
